links.outcome: Multimodal LLM agreement with surgeon consensus on fracture stability using radiographs
links.effect: Both models achieved overall accuracy 0.75 (95% CI, 0.56-0.94); ChatGPT moderate and Claude fair agreement; several criteria near chance and specificity limited.
links.quote: Performance across several criteria approached chance levels, and specificity was limited.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and agreement of two multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT and Claude) against hand surgeon consensus in interpreting radiographs for distal radius fracture stability using LaFontaine criteria.
